question:
Select the number than can replace the question mark (?) in the following equation.

12 + 8-5 times (1)/(2)times 12-lbrace{45div (34-19)rbrace}=?
solution:
Concept Used:

Follow the BODMAS rule according to the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0dde522f65134a981f8db6f1ac5aebe5108510a68c758df909f765f209687bd.png] 

Calculation:

12 + 8-5 × (1)/(2)× 12-lbrace{45÷ (34-19)rbrace}=?

⇒12 + 8 – 5 × 1/2 × 12 – {45 ÷ 15} = ?

⇒ 12 + 8 – 5 × 1/2 × 12 – 3 = ?

⇒ 12 + 8 – 5 × 6 – 3 = ?

⇒ 20 – 30 – 3 = ?

⇒ -10 – 3 = ?

⇒ -13 = ?

**∴ The value of ? is -13**
